purpose: PDB type/layout recovery lane (test-estate phase 4, real-binary R4)
state: PDB NAMES are ingested and applied; PDB TYPES are not. src/symbols/pdb.rs parses the TPI stream (LF_PROCEDURE return type + arglist, struct field layouts) and src/ir/pdb_fields.rs applies FIELD hints only -- its own docstring says it 'does not infer the concrete struct type of a base register yet'. Nothing applies procedure prototypes to recovered signatures. The missing link is a VA -> TypeIndex mapping: prototypes are TPI records keyed by type_index with no address, and the reader parses PublicSymbol records (name + address, no type) but not S_GPROC32/S_LPROC32, which carry both.
